_why: M-06 step 02. The ported source is fingerprinted and stays unedited; every addition to ALIAS is named here instead. Same shape as decision S for VOICE: verbatim, plus a list. Anything not on this list is a defect.
_inherit_why: Keying, not authoring. The source holds eleven wire aliases under one combined key and no part is named that. None of the eleven is colour-specific, so all three parts take the same list. No new word enters the corpus here.
_added_why: ring: the book says 'the light ring' throughout and never bare 'ring' on introduction, so a child asking about 'the light' had no route. clips: the book gives them no second name; 'four clips' is the architect's call and is recorded as adding no route the part name did not already carry.
